'''Fett Set Your Course for Alderaan, then Hoth, then Yavin''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett]]
* '''Published:''' 1 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Strategy:''' The Ultimate Power In The Universe
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 The Ultimate Power In The Universe.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Essentially, this is the standard SYCFA deck, geared towards capitalizing on the -2 deploy and +2 force drain with the Imperial Star Destroyers.

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start off with Objective.

Get Gunner, pull Superlaser

Move to Alderaan, sit around pulling DS sites and gunners.

Use Million Voices to pull CPI, if not already drawn

Blow alderaan, deploy hoth, and move there.

Blow Hoth, deploy Yavin, hopefully already have DB.

Deploy sites & destroyers, force drain to death.  My destroyers drain for +1 when within 2 parsecs of Chiraneau, and +2 from TUPITU
